notes: Alphabetical Contents on pdf pp3-8 (2 columns, 'page...TITLE.....genre'), OCR at 300 dpi per column, titles recased from caps and OCR junk (trailing dots/digits) stripped by rule; a few fixed by hand. Printed page = pdfPage. Every entry's title searched in full-page OCR of its page: 715 of 807 found there (conf high; 19 corrected to the page where the title was found, e.g. OCR 9 for 2 in page numbers); 92 weak (noisy OCR of title or page, conf med). Several tunes per page. Classical items (pp402+) carry composer from the parenthesis. Genre labels dropped. Highlights guide at pp477+ not indexed. Index lists ~808 titles though cover says 1010 songs; titles missing from the contents list are not indexed (some tunes on the pages may be absent from the index). One unreadable title ('He...', Inspirational, p182) dropped.
